title: Steel Grand Astral Hotel and Elevator Chaos!
content: This is my latest astral journey in an astral hotel including the weird ride in its wonky elevator. [Steel Grand Astral Hotel and Elevator Chaos!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YA_RRdPtaJE) I've seen different posts on here about others experiences with crazy elevators, malls and hotels; so, please add this experience to the growing list. :-)
